charts.title: WASP-156 b: orbits around WASP-156
charts.description: The orbits of WASP-156's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-156 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Lafarga et al. 2026 (2026MNRAS.tmp..940L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LAFARGA_ET_AL_2026): P 3.8361629 d

charts.title: WASP-156 b: its transit
charts.description: WASP-156 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (43, 70, 71) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 270380593, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 10-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 10-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
